summary: Design exception workflows, visibility requirements, and dashboards for coordinated supply-chain control. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Supply-chain control tower training helps leaders, logistics managers, planners, and implementation teams coordinate visibility and exception responses. Participants map ERP, warehouse, transport, and supplier events using SCOR concepts and GS1 EPCIS, then define exception priorities, owners, and escalation paths. They also practise inventory segmentation and supplier scorecards, and specify dashboards for measures such as OTIF; AI-assisted prioritization is discussed conceptually, not built or deployed.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who coordinate supply-chain visibility and response across systems, sites, suppliers, and operating teams.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with supply-chain, logistics, planning, warehouse, procurement, or ERP processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if you want to adapt the exercises; the course does not specify a required platform or pre-course software installation.
